episodes.title: Whitney Webb EXPLAINS the Disturbing “Satanic Cult” Allegations Behind The Finders
episodes.description:
In 1987, six children were found in Florida, sparking a disturbing investigation into The Finders. Decades later, Whitney Webb and Elizabeth Vos revisited the case, exploring Satanic cult allegations, FBI files, and disputed CIA connections. What do the documents actually reveal?

Watch this documentary to uncover the facts, allegations, and unanswered questions behind this mysterious case.
